questions.question: During the driving test, when asked to make a turn, you should:

options.text: Not use a turn signal because you were told to turn.
Check traffic only on your right side.
Check traffic in all directions.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check traffic in all directions.
questions.explanation: When making a turn during the driving test, always check traffic in all directions and use your turn signal.

questions.question: If the driving test route does not include a railroad crossing, you:

options.text: Will not need to do anything about crossings.
May be asked to explain how you would cross railroad tracks.
Will have to take the test again on a different route with a railroad crossing.

questions.correctAnswerText: May be asked to explain how you would cross railroad tracks.
questions.explanation: If your test route does not include a railroad crossing, the examiner may ask you to explain and show how you would safely cross railroad tracks at a simulated location.

questions.question: When parallel parking on the driver's side, you should:

options.text: Drive directly forward into the parking space.
Back past the space, then pull forward into it.
Drive past the space, then back into it.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive past the space, then back into it.
questions.explanation: To parallel park into a space on your left, drive past the space first. Then back up slowly, bringing the rear of your vehicle close to the rear of the space. Your vehicle must fit completely within the boundaries.

questions.question: If a student drops an item while boarding a school bus, the student should:

options.text: Stop and pick up the item.
Ask another student to pick it up.
Ask the driver to pick it up.

questions.correctAnswerText: Ask the driver to pick it up.
questions.explanation: If a student tries to pick up a dropped item, the driver may not see them. This is dangerous. Students should move to a safe area, get the driver's attention, and let the driver retrieve the item.

questions.question: If you must drive in high winds, you should:

options.text: Loosen your grip on the steering wheel.
Drive faster.
Slow down.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down.
questions.explanation: School buses have large sides that wind can push. In windy conditions, grip the steering wheel firmly, watch for wind gusts, and reduce your speed. Contact your dispatcher if needed.

questions.question: Adjust a bus's mirrors:

options.text: Before you start driving.
While you are driving.
At the first stoplight after you start your shift.

questions.correctAnswerText: Before you start driving.
questions.explanation: Always check and adjust all mirrors before you begin driving.

questions.question: ABS helps you:

options.text: Lock up your wheels.
Keep your wheels from locking up.
Count the students boarding the bus.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep your wheels from locking up.
questions.explanation: An Anti-Lock Braking System (ABS) prevents your wheels from locking up when you brake hard on a slippery surface.

questions.question: During the driving test at a railroad crossing, you should:

options.text: Pass another vehicle on the tracks if it is going too slow.
Get out and check for a train.
Not change gears while on the tracks.

questions.correctAnswerText: Not change gears while on the tracks.
questions.explanation: While any part of your vehicle is on railroad tracks, do not stop, change gears, pass another vehicle, or change lanes.

questions.question: When operating a school bus, mirrors should be adjusted:

options.text: During your drive.
Before you begin to drive.
After your drive is finished.

questions.correctAnswerText: Before you begin to drive.
questions.explanation: Proper mirror adjustment is critical for safe school bus operation. Always check each mirror before you start driving.

questions.question: If there is a fire on a school bus, the students:

options.text: Must leave the bus.
Should stay on the bus but move away from the fire.
Should stay in their seats.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must leave the bus.
questions.explanation: If a school bus is on fire or there is a threat of fire, the driver must evacuate all students from the bus immediately.

questions.question: Where is the overhead rearview mirror located?

options.text: On the right side of the bus.
On the steering wheel of the bus.
Above the windshield inside the bus.

questions.correctAnswerText: Above the windshield inside the bus.
questions.explanation: The overhead rearview mirror is mounted above the windshield on the driver's side. Use it to watch students inside the bus.

questions.question: A student is causing a disturbance while other students are getting off the bus. What should you do?

options.text: Walk to the back of the bus right away to stop the disturbance while students unload.
Wait until all students are off the bus, then handle the disturbance.
Ask a student near the problem to handle it while you watch the unloading.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wait until all students are off the bus, then handle the disturbance.
questions.explanation: Focus on safely unloading students. Once they are all off the bus and away, then address any behavior problems on the bus.

questions.question: When making a turn during your driving test, you should:

options.text: Use your turn signal only if other cars are nearby.
Check traffic only in the direction you are turning.
Check traffic in all directions.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check traffic in all directions.
questions.explanation: Always check traffic in all directions and use your turn signal when making a turn.

questions.question: An encroachment is when:

options.text: A driver does not show up for their basic skills test.
A vehicle touches a boundary line during the basic skills test.
A driver fails one section of the basic skills test.

questions.correctAnswerText: A vehicle touches a boundary line during the basic skills test.
questions.explanation: An encroachment happens when your vehicle touches or crosses a boundary line during a basic skills test exercise. Each encroachment counts as an error.

questions.question: At a passive railroad crossing, who decides whether to proceed?

options.text: The driver.
A control device.
The vehicle in front of you.

questions.correctAnswerText: The driver.
questions.explanation: A passive railroad crossing has no traffic control devices. The driver must decide if it is safe to cross the tracks.

questions.question: When properly adjusted, what should the flat mirrors on a school bus show?

options.text: The sides of the bus.
The ground under the bus.
The front tires touching the ground.

questions.correctAnswerText: The sides of the bus.
questions.explanation: Properly adjusted flat mirrors show 200 feet behind the bus, the base of each rear wheel, and the sides of the bus.

questions.question: During a basic vehicle controls skills test, where should your vehicle end up?

options.text: In the general area the examiner described.
In the exact position the examiner described.
Within three feet of the position the examiner described.

questions.correctAnswerText: In the exact position the examiner described.
questions.explanation: Your vehicle must end each exercise in the exact position the examiner described. Not finishing correctly can result in failure of the basic control skills test.

questions.question: During the vehicle inspection test, you must check all of the following except:

options.text: The power steering belt.
The water compressor belt.
The alternator belt.

questions.correctAnswerText: The water compressor belt.
questions.explanation: You will be asked to check the power steering, water pump, alternator, and air compressor belts if the vehicle has them.

questions.question: How should students board a school bus?

options.text: In a single-file line.
In pairs.
Without using the handrail.

questions.correctAnswerText: In a single-file line.
questions.explanation: Students should board slowly in a single-file line. They should use the handrail for safety.

questions.question: Where is the overhead rearview mirror located?

options.text: On the outside left of the bus.
On the outside right of the bus.
Above the windshield inside the bus.

questions.correctAnswerText: Above the windshield inside the bus.
questions.explanation: The overhead rearview mirror is mounted above the windshield on the driver's side of the bus.
